headline: 智能体正从「能跑」滑向「能管」：今天的开源与论文同时押注记忆、编排与自我改进，而 Minecraft 里的智能体蜂群用官僚主义证明规模不等于文明。

overview_bullets.text: claude-mem 把跨会话持久上下文做成通用层，配合 RoboArchitect 的持久记忆，说明「记不住」已被当作智能体工程的头号缺陷来修。
R²Orch 与 CEPO 两篇论文同时把矛头指向多智能体编排的手工课程与提示耦合，学术侧开始系统化地「让智能体自己设计智能体」。
FreeToken、lightpanda、Handy、hex 集中上榜，桌面端本地推理与离线语音/浏览器工具形成一条清晰的「去云端」支线。
「大家都用 LLM 来思考了」与「AI 写的代码仍需人来工程化系统」同榜，社区对 LLM 的日常化依赖已从惊叹转为审视。
AiSOC 把 LLM 智能体塞进安全运营并留可回放决策账本，而 jailbreaks 榜单与「Muse 是伪装成助手的监控网络」提醒同一套能力的两副面孔。

executive_summary: 今天的信号很一致：智能体的瓶颈已从模型能力转移到记忆、编排与治理这些工程与制度层面，谁先把这些「脏活」标准化，谁就拿到下一轮的话语权。

editor_note.core: 今天最该记住的是「智能体的竞争已从模型层下沉到记忆与编排层」：claude-mem 与 RoboArchitect 解决记不住，R²Orch 与 CEPO 解决不会自己分工，这三件事拼起来才是可用的智能体系统，而不是又一个更长的思维链。
editor_note.cross_signal: 开源侧的持久记忆（claude-mem）、论文侧的持久记忆（RoboArchitect）与编排自改进（R²Orch/CEPO）在同一日出现，说明「上下文工程」正从个人技巧变成可复用的工程范式；同时 FreeToken、lightpanda、Handy 的集体上榜印证本地化部署是这条范式的落地载体。
editor_note.counterintuitive: 热度最高的不是任何一项能力突破，而是 Minecraft 里智能体蜂群「溺死在官僚主义」——这恰恰是今天最有价值的结果：它证明多智能体系统的失败模式不是算力不足，而是协调开销随规模超线性增长，与论文侧急着做自动编排形成微妙对冲。
editor_note.risk: 最值得警惕的是「AI 生成内容污染知识底座」这条线：AI 百科错误百出、HackerBooks 由 Claude 一次性生成 1.6 万本书目、jailbreaks 清单公开传播，三者共同指向同一盲点——我们正在用不可验证的 AI 输出去喂养下一代的训练与检索语料，而 AiSOC 式的「可回放决策账本」目前只在安全领域被认真对待。

contradictions: 社区一边热议「大家都用 LLM 来思考」，一边高赞「AI 写的代码仍需人来工程化系统」，对 LLM 的依赖程度与信任程度明显不匹配。
开源侧在推本地化、离线、自托管的工具链（FreeToken、Handy、AiSOC），但热度最高的智能体项目（claude-mem、Claude-Code-Game-Studios）几乎全部绑定闭源商业模型，开放叙事与依赖现实相悖。
论文侧主张用自我改进与自动编排降低人工设计成本，Minecraft 蜂群实验却显示更多智能体带来更多协调失败，规模化的收益方向存在分歧。
underrated: AiSOC：开源 AI 安全运营中心，带可回放决策账本与 MCP server，是今日唯一认真处理智能体可审计性的项目。
RoboArchitect：把机器人 agent harness 从手工设计变为自动生成，并引入持久记忆，工程价值被 40.4 的低热度严重低估。
CEPO：把协调者与执行者的提示优化解耦，是解决多智能体提示耦合的直接方案，热度仅 52.3。
Lightpanda：专为 AI 与自动化设计的无头浏览器，是智能体上网能力的基础设施，热度不及同类工具。
AI fan wikis riddled with errors：AI 生成内容污染游戏文化知识库，是训练数据自我污染的早期实证。

sections.name: 开源项目
sections.summary: 榜单被智能体基础设施与本地化工具占据，记忆层、游戏工作室式多智能体编排、离线语音与无头浏览器构成今日开源主线。

sections.name: 论文与研究
sections.summary: 研究侧集体转向智能体的「元能力」——自我改进、提示优化、持久记忆与视频-动作世界模型，System-1/System-2 协同被重新提上台面。

sections.name: 社区舆论
sections.summary: HN 讨论从「AI 能做什么」转向「AI 把我们变成了什么」：思考外包、代码工程化、AI 百科污染与监控化助手构成四条批评线。

sections.name: 产业与新闻
sections.summary: 今日采集条目中缺少明确的公司/融资/产品发布类新闻，产业信号主要隐含在开源项目的商业化路径与安全产品化中。

comments.one_liner: pingdotgg 开源的 t3code 代码项目仓库
comments.why: 知名开源作者的新仓库冲上趋势榜，说明社区对个人品牌驱动的脚手架项目仍愿意用 star 投票，新项目冷启动的门槛被作者信誉直接抹平。
comments.stance: 个人 IP 已成为开源项目最便宜的获客渠道，代码质量反而排在第二位。

comments.one_liner: 涵盖 LLM、RAG 与真实 AI agent 应用的深度教程合集
comments.why: 把 LLM、RAG 与 agent 的实战教程集中成库，降低了工程团队从论文到可运行原型的转换成本，教程库正在替代部分文档与课程的角色。
comments.stance: 教程聚合比再发一篇 benchmark 更能推动落地，这类仓库该被当作基础设施看待。

comments.one_liner: 为各类 coding agent 提供跨会话持久记忆的工具，记录会话内容并用 AI 压缩后回注到后续会话。
comments.why: 跨会话持久记忆被做成通用层并兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等多家代理，代理的上下文从一次性消耗品变成可累积资产，切换工具的成本随之下降。
comments.stance: 记忆层会成为代理生态里最容易被锁定的一环，谁掌握压缩与注入策略谁就掌握粘性。

comments.one_liner: 作者个人 jailbreak 提示词合集仓库
comments.why: 越狱提示词被整理成公开清单，模型厂商的对齐补丁会按这份清单逐条打，攻防节奏从零散试探变成清单式军备竞赛。
comments.stance: 这类仓库是红队资产也是滥用入口，公开可以，但别指望它长期不被平台下架。

comments.one_liner: 支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的本地语音听写工具
comments.why: 语音听写完全跑在本地三端，意味着音频不再离开设备，企业内网与隐私敏感场景的合规障碍被移除。
comments.stance: 本地语音输入是云端转写服务的直接替代品，隐私溢价会持续压缩云厂商的份额。

comments.one_liner: OpenMausBot 是一个开源的 Grok Bot 替代方案，内置可供 bot 操作的虚拟机。
comments.why: 给机器人配一台可操作的虚拟机，等于把执行环境从沙箱对话升级为可读写真实系统的执行体，能力上限和风险面同时被拉高。
comments.stance: 方向诱人但危险，没有强隔离与审计日志的开源 VM 代理不该被随意跑在主力机上。

comments.one_liner: 社区维护的免费公开 API 汇总清单
comments.why: 免费 API 清单长期占据趋势榜，反映开发者对可即取数据的刚性需求，也意味着大量项目的第一版原型都建立在这份目录之上。
comments.stance: 它是被严重低估的公共品，但条目质量参差，维护者该引入可用性校验而非只做收录。

comments.one_liner: Lightpanda 推出的面向 AI 与自动化场景的无头浏览器。
comments.why: 专为 AI 与自动化设计的无头浏览器，直接针对代理抓取与操作网页时的资源开销和兼容性问题，代理做网页任务的门槛因此下移。
comments.stance: 通用浏览器给代理用本来就浪费，专用化是正确方向，但生态兼容性会是长期硬仗。

comments.one_liner: 把 Claude Code 改造成游戏开发工作室，含 49 个 agent 与 72 项工作流技能
comments.why: 用 49 个角色化 agent 加工作流技能模拟工作室层级，把「多 agent 协作」从演示推进到可复用的组织模板，游戏开发成了第一个被完整拆解的行业。
comments.stance: 角色扮演式编排好看但容易空转，真正的考验是产出能不能过审而不是流程像不像。

comments.one_liner: 完全离线运行、免费开源且可扩展的语音转文字应用
comments.why: 离线可扩展的语音转文字应用把模型选择权交回用户，插件式扩展让社区能自行补语言与领域词表，绕开厂商锁定。
comments.stance: 离线优先的语音工具会先吃掉会议记录与笔记场景，云端方案只剩实时协作这一块阵地。

comments.one_liner: 探讨 AGI 规模化是否取决于 System-1 为 System-2 提供可执行内容的论文
comments.why: 把 AGI 进展的瓶颈从扩大 System-2 转向与轻量 System-1 协同设计，等于质疑继续堆算力与推理长度的路线，会直接影响下一轮训练预算的分配逻辑。
comments.stance: 这是对 scaling 叙事的正面挑战，但缺少可验证的对照实验前，它更像一个漂亮的问题而非答案。

comments.one_liner: 通过技能内化循环中的自我博弈实现 agent 编排递归自我改进的 R^2Orch 方法
comments.why: 用自博弈在技能内化循环里自动生成课程，针对的是手工设计课程与优势坍缩两个具体失效点，编排层的学习成本因此从人力转向算力。
comments.stance: 编排器的自我改进是 agent 落地的真正瓶颈，这个方向比再堆一个更大的基座模型更有杠杆。

comments.one_liner: 为 VLA 模型引入分层前瞻与动作引导世界接地的 HiFOR 方法
comments.why: 把未来预测与动作引导的世界接地结合进 VLA，让机器人操作从反应式转向带前瞻的规划，长时序任务的失败率因此有下降空间。
comments.stance: VLA 的竞争已从感知精度转向预测能力，没有世界模型的一侧会被迅速拉开差距。

comments.one_liner: 通过 agentic 控制在实时视频世界模型中操控任意世界的 Wizard 框架
comments.why: 用 agent 实时操控视频世界模型，把游戏逻辑与可渲染世界解耦，内容生产从预先制作转向运行时生成，玩家定制成为默认能力。
comments.stance: 这是生成式内容对游戏工业流程的实质侵入，但实时性与一致性的工程债还没人算清。

comments.one_liner: 复用视频基础模型先验的统一图像生成框架 FrameForge
comments.why: 复用视频基础模型的时间变换先验来做统一图像生成，省去为每种条件单独训练，多任务图像生成的边际成本被压低。
comments.stance: 视频模型反哺图像生成是顺理成章的路径，统一模型的赢家会从视频侧产生而非图像侧。

comments.one_liner: CEPO：一个把协调与执行分工的 prompt 优化框架，用于提升多智能体系统的整体表现
comments.why: 把协调者与执行者的提示词解耦，意味着多智能体系统的调优从逐个智能体手工试错转为可复用的通用流程，直接降低搭建 MAS 的工程门槛。
comments.stance: 方向正确：提示词优化该分层，而不是继续堆在单个智能体身上。

comments.one_liner: WorldBridge：在 World Action Models 中打通视频预测与动作执行，以提升具身任务泛化能力
comments.why: 把视频预测与动作生成放到同一框架下对齐，让具身模型面对新任务时能先想象画面演化再决定动作，泛化能力从记忆任务转向推演任务。
comments.stance: 视频作为动作的先验是当前最实在的泛化路径，比纯数据堆量更有前景。

comments.one_liner: RoboArchitect：自动为机器人智能体设计带持久记忆的控制框架，替代逐一手工搭建
comments.why: 把机器人智能体的控制外壳从手工编写变成自动搜索，意味着换一台机器人或换一个基准不再需要重写整套调度逻辑，冻结策略的复用率被抬高。
comments.stance: 自动设计外壳比再训一个策略更划算，这类工作会吃掉大量手工 harness 的生存空间。

comments.one_liner: OmniDiff：用 Rust 编写的开源 Git difftool，可对代码、图片、PDF、压缩包等多种内容做快速 diff
comments.why: 把 diff 从纯文本扩展到图片、PDF、字体、二进制并做到百毫秒级，意味着代码审查工具开始按内容语义而非行号对齐，Rust 生态又多一个可替代老工具的入口。
comments.stance: 内容感知 diff 是刚需，但真正的门槛在于多格式解析的准确率而非速度。

comments.one_liner: HackerBooks：收录约 1.65 万本在 HN 评论中被提及的书籍，并链接回原始讨论
comments.why: 把十七年 HN 评论里被反复提及的书目连同出处一起结构化，等于给社区口碑做了一次可检索的沉淀，推荐系统的冷启动数据多了一个公开来源。
comments.stance: 带评论溯源的榜单比算法推荐可信，这类社区考古项目价值在数据而非界面。

comments.one_liner: 一则关于 Minecraft 中 AI 智能体集群尝试建立文明却陷入官僚流程的报道
comments.why: 多智能体在开放环境里自发形成层级与流程却产出低下，暴露出协调开销会吞掉并行收益，给所有押注 agent swarm 的团队一记成本预警。
comments.stance: 这不是失败案例而是负结果证据：智能体数量增加时，官僚化是默认结局。

comments.one_liner: 一篇讨论人们如今普遍借助 LLM 进行思考的帖子
comments.why: 当 LLM 从查资料工具变成思考过程本身，用户的判断力被外包给模型，错误会以更自信的语气传播，且难以被本人察觉。
comments.stance: 把思考交给模型是认知上的净损失，工具该辅助推理而不是替代推理。

comments.one_liner: 一篇主张 AI 能写更多代码、但系统设计仍需工程师把关的文章
comments.why: 代码生成比例上升后，瓶颈从写代码转移到定义边界、接口与失败模式，工程师的价值评估标准随之从产出速度转向系统设计质量。
comments.stance: 同意且更进一步：不会设计系统的人用 AI 只会更快地造出更难维护的东西。

comments.one_liner: 一则关于 AI 生成的游戏粉丝 wiki 错误频出、干扰游戏文化讨论的报道
comments.why: AI 生成的 wiki 内容以低成本占据搜索结果，玩家与研究者查到的设定事实被污染，游戏文化的公共知识底座出现系统性失真。
comments.stance: 这是知识基础设施的腐蚀，平台该给 AI 生成内容加可追溯标记而不是放任。

comments.one_liner: 一篇指称 Muse AI 助手实为商业监控网络的文章
comments.why: 以助手名义收集行为数据并接入商业变现，意味着用户对 AI 助手的信任被转化为可交易的画像资产，隐私边界在交互层被悄悄改写。
comments.stance: 这类产品该按监控软件对待，披露义务必须前置到安装之前。

it_1f57a957deebe754.title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
it_1f57a957deebe754.summary: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. Our answer is a qualified yes. We study conditional interaction, a predict--gate--execute--update loop: System-1 estimates each candidate's utility, System-2 executes those admitted by an adaptive threshold, and the outcomes update System-1. The loop spans training, test-time reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and agentic tool use, with utility and cost defined by the application. Under ideal screening and equal execution costs, execution compute falls by a factor approaching 1/ρ_u, where ρ_u is the density of utility-relevant interactions (cost-weighted when costs differ); prediction errors, exploration, and distribution shift reduce the saving. We bound selection regret by predictor error and the utility margin. These results motivate our central hypothesis: ρ_u is a measurable coordinate of scaling efficiency and makes informative compute a better description of scaling than total compute.

it_4185c9fbf8453de2.title: R^2Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
it_4185c9fbf8453de2.summary: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score. To address these challenges, we propose R^2Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrator on self-chosen tasks, and an outer loop that improves how the inner loop improves. To support this paradigm, we introduce Recursive Learnability, a training objective that rewards a Proposer for choosing tasks whose rollouts keep reaching different outcomes as skills are withdrawn. Built on this objective, we further propose Skill Withdrawal, in which the outer loop withdraws each skill once a controlled evaluation within self-play shows that the orchestrator performs as well without it. Moreover, the two loops form one cycle: failures are distilled into skills, skills into parameters, and withdrawals lead the Proposer to new failures, so the orchestrator moves toward zero-skill deployment. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that R^2Orch consistently outperforms baselines across question answering, math, code, and interactive tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/R2Orch.

it_35f90c72d7beb0d1.title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
it_35f90c72d7beb0d1.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

it_e61ed0808ad02b7a.title: Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
it_e61ed0808ad02b7a.summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.

it_a1103b9d73d6e545.title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
it_a1103b9d73d6e545.summary: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visual transformations at different temporal scales. This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations. We propose FrameForge, which captures two complementary aspects of such relations. Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals. Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) models how the condition is transformed into the target through a latent intermediate state, with a reasoning-bottleneck attention mask encouraging information propagation through this pathway. Experiments on DreamBench, COCO2017, and GEdit-Bench show that FrameForge achieves superior performance in subject-driven generation, canny-to-image generation, and image editing among the compared methods.

it_421ee6dfba7e78bb.title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
it_421ee6dfba7e78bb.summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) require both effective coordination and specialized task execution. Existing prompt optimization approaches typically couple these functions within agent-specific prompts. We introduce Coordinator-Executor Prompt Optimization (CEPO), a general framework for improving prompt optimization in MAS. CEPO separates system-level coordination from agent-level execution through a shared coordinator prompt and agent-specific executor prompts, and guides their updates according to their respective roles. This structure allows shared coordination rules to be refined consistently across agents while keeping execution instructions separately adjustable. CEPO provides the prompt structure and optimization guidance, while existing prompt optimizers perform the underlying search. Extensive experiments spanning 11 benchmarks across four domains demonstrate that applying CEPO to four existing prompt optimizers consistently improves their performance. Ablations and qualitative analyses support the proposed design, while controlled studies on a document-understanding MAS further demonstrate improved optimization budget efficiency and performance scaling with the number of agents.

it_3619beed1c78d1bb.title: WorldBridge: Bridging Video and Action for Task Generalization in World Action Models
it_3619beed1c78d1bb.summary: Achieving the broad task generalization of embodied models in physical environments remains a central challenge in robot learning. We study this challenge in World Action Models (WAMs) through two complementary capabilities: video generalization, which predicts the visual evolution of new tasks, and action generalization, which translates these predictions into executable behavior through a video-to-action bridge. By varying video and action supervision for tasks outside an initial training set, we examine their respective contributions to task transfer. On RoboTwin 2.0, using only in-distribution video-action supervision yields a 25.07% success rate on out-of-distribution tasks. Introducing videos of these tasks without their action labels raises success to 55.90%, while adding just one action-labeled demonstration per task further improves it to 70.70%. These findings suggest that broader video coverage enables task transfer by leveraging existing inverse-dynamics capabilities, while even sparse action supervision further strengthens those capabilities. Guided by this perspective, we introduce WorldBridge, a WAM with separate video and action experts connected through structured attention and trained with joint flow matching. WorldBridge incorporates visual memory at two temporal scales and action forcing, alongside a unified data processing pipeline that standardizes and filters heterogeneous robot trajectories and egocentric hand-derived supervision. Across multiple manipulation benchmarks, WorldBridge achieves state-of-the-art performance among the compared methods, including 96.23% on RoboTwin 2.0 full data setting and 80.9% on clean to random setting, 82.8% on RoboCasa GR1 TableTop, and 57.6% on DOMINO Level-1. Our study highlights the complementary roles of video prediction and action grounding in developing robots that generalize across tasks.

it_f23967052effefea.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
it_f23967052effefea.summary: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.
